lines.text: An angel carries the narrator away in the Spirit into a wilderness to see a woman on a scarlet beast.
The woman is dressed in blue and white and holds a golden cup, and Nineveh is written on her forehead.
The beast will come up out of the Abyss, and its seven heads are seven mountains.
The ten kings receive authority for seven years with the beast and make war against the Lamb.
The waters are peoples and nations, and the woman is the great city that rules the kings of the earth.
